catalog.purpose: GNU assembler, linker and binary utilities
qualification_gaps: Install the frozen exact closure, retain /usr/share/doc notices, and perform role-specific first-use qualification.

catalog.title: binutils

activation: No shell activation is required for an APT installation: the commands are in /usr/bin.
The functional check additionally needs Python 3 and a working C compiler named cc. It creates disposable C/ELF fixtures and preserves command logs in the check build directory.

examples.description: List the files registered by the system package manager.
Inspect ELF headers and sections, including DWARF debug sections.
List defined symbols ordered by address.
Disassemble a named function using Intel x86 syntax; replace my_function with its actual symbol.
Map an address from the selected executable to its function and source line; replace the example address.
Create a deterministic static archive from already compiled object files.
Preserve separate debug information and attach its GNU debug link to a stripped copy.
Run the declared real ELF, archive, source-line and split-debug checks.

locations.purpose: Independent verified source, input, data or upstream distribution.

locations.label: System package files
locations.purpose: Ask dpkg-query -L for the actual installed file list, including multiarch packages.

locations.label: GNU ELF tools
locations.purpose: readelf, nm, objdump, addr2line, ar, objcopy, as and ld; x86_64-linux-gnu-prefixed commands are provided by the exact sibling package.

locations.label: Binutils shared libraries
locations.purpose: Matched libbfd, libopcodes, libctf and libsframe libraries from the same Ubuntu binutils source revision.

locations.label: Package copyright and changelog
locations.purpose: Installed distribution notices and changelog; see sibling package documentation for their files.

notes: The wrapper pins Ubuntu 2.42-4ubuntu2.10. GNU command version banners report upstream 2.42; the wrapper database observation and locked .deb hashes establish the distribution revision.

The functional check uses this prefix explicitly, verifies same-prefix binutils sibling library loading, compiles actual C objects, links/runs a static archive consumer, and tests separate debug-link resolution.
Version banners or successful package installation alone do not establish these functional checks.
Raw addresses belong to the selected ELF image; account for load bias when converting runtime PIE/ASLR addresses.
The original package definition and runtime dependencies remain available. No system package is installed or removed merely by querying this resource.
usage.summary: GNU ELF and DWARF inspection, symbols, disassembly, source-line lookup, deterministic static archives, assembler/linker, and debug-section processing with readelf, nm, objdump, addr2line, ar and objcopy.
